_text: [excited] Pop! A new flower shoots out of his *nose*. [dramatic, building] And it rots. Right there. On live *TV*. [excited] He sweats, so the glue melts, and a THOUSAND flowers slide off like wet stickers. [dramatic, booming] Underneath? A THOUSAND rotten ones. [amused] Even your fly leaves you, for *Derek*. [amused] Derek loses. You can smell him from across the *mall*. [proud, warm] Fourteen rotten flowers... and ONE that finally blooms.
